article.content: ⚽️ Champions League updates from 8pm BST ⚽️ Live scoreboard | Champions League table | Mail Scott Arsenal’s last three visits to Munich have ended badly. In reverse order: 0-1 (2024), 1-5 (2017), 1-5 (2015). All three worthy of a large bräukeller-infused GULP. On the other hand, Arsenal won the last meeting between these two sides, 3-1 last November at the Emirates, and they go into this match having won 10 of their 11 games in all competitions so far this season. Bayern by contrast aren’t at their usual steamrolling best: OK, they’ve just mullered RB Leipzig 6-1, but before that they dropped Bundesliga points at Augsburg (2-2) and should really have been beaten by Viking in a 3-3 draw last week. So both teams have positives to draw on and negatives to try their best to ignore. Kick-off is at 8pm BST. It’s on! Continue reading...

Arsenal faces a formidable historical hurdle as the club prepares for an 8pm BST kickoff in Germany, with past fixtures at the venue yielding heavily lopsided defeats according to [Sport | The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2026/oct/21/bayern-munich-v-arsenal-champions-league-live). The London side's previous three trips to Munich resulted in a tight **0-1** loss in **2024**, preceded by consecutive **1-5** thrashings in **2017** and **2015**. 

## Historical Struggles in Munich

The English club enters the latest fixture carrying the heavy baggage of these previous encounters. Reporting on the upcoming action, the publication notes that the historical scorelines from their last three visits are all worthy of a large "bräukeller-infused" reflection for traveling supporters attempting to make sense of the recurring nightmare in Bavaria. 

The UEFA Champions League remains Europe's premier club competition, drawing intense global scrutiny during mid-week matchdays alongside parallel fixtures such as [Como v Manchester United](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/como-v-manchester-united-champions-league-live) and other continental showdowns detailed in our [Aston Villa v Viking, Real Madrid v RB Leipzig and more](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/aston-villa-v-viking-real-madrid-v-rb-leipzig-and-more-champions) coverage. 

## The Broader European Context

Matches between English and German heavyweights often dictate the momentum of the league phase, shaping qualification brackets as autumn fixtures pile up. For visiting squads, overcoming hostile stadiums and psychological ghosts of past hammerings is just as demanding as dealing with tactical setups on the pitch. Fans and pundits alike frequently debate whether historical precedent carries any weight for modern squads, though supporters trapped in memories of past blowouts understandably feel anxious.

## What to Watch

Observers will monitor whether the visitors can alter their tactical approach to frustrate the hosts early on, potentially shifting the psychological balance of the tie. An early goal for either side could completely rewrite the script of this classic European rivalry.
